scenarios.expected: Assignment persists without deciding the Request or reserving it. Dispositioned Requests leave the undecided Inbox and retain their outcome. Resolve requires an explanatory Full Thread note; Decline is absent from the current Triage menu. A concurrent disposition produces a clear lost-race result rather than a second outcome.
scenarios.actual: 18 browser steps passed, plus the Business User access step. Browsing the Inbox list and Oliver Grant's Portal view left R-51 New. Inbox opened on the Requests tab with the chip "Status: New, Read" and 29 New or Read rows ordered by urgency, then oldest first. Opening R-50 from its row showed Requester, Converts to Contract · DOC-030 inbox Supplier agreement, Department, Urgency High, Form responses with the Description answer (no separate Description card, because the Contract type's Form collects Description), and Attachments; opening it changed New to Read. Matter Request R-52, whose Form does not collect Description, showed a Description card. The PDF and Word attachments opened in the viewer and Download saved the submitted bytes. Assign on the row, Search people, choosing Nadia Haddad and Save assignment saved her without changing the status; her own session still had Triage. The Portal showed "Legal Owner Nadia Haddad", the Read pill and "Your request has been opened by the Legal team." Cancel kept the assignment, the avatar control reassigned it, Unassigned cleared it and the Portal showed "Legal Owner Not assigned yet". An aborted people load showed "People could not be loaded." with Retry; a failed save showed "The assignment could not be saved. Try again." and kept the saved state. The composer started on Legal Only; a Shared with requester question reached the Requester and the Legal Only note did not. Triage offered Convert to contract, Convert to matter and Resolve request without converting, and no Decline. A blank Resolution note (required) was refused with "Explain why this request is being resolved without converting." and Cancel posted nothing. R-51, assigned to Nadia, was resolved by Daniel: Status card Resolved, note in Comments at the full_thread tier and on the Portal, email "Your request is resolved: R-51 · …", assignee read-only, Assign and Triage gone, attachments kept; the Requester's later reply left it resolved. Nadia's competing resolution of R-52 made the dialog say "Somebody else already resolved this request." and "Close this to read what they recorded." with Close, and only her note was posted. The Status filter showed only Read or only New Requests; Remove Status filter and Status Resolved listed R-51; Status Declined listed seeded R-1 with its reason and no Assign or Triage. Converted R-53 kept assignee, Description and Form responses, showed C-128 and Converted by Daniel Okafor on the Status card, and had no Attachments card, Comments, Assign or Triage. Oliver Grant and Rosa Iglesias (Business Users) were sent from /inbox and /inbox/50 to /portal and got 403 from the staff list, detail, assignment and convert APIs.

work2 is shared with other DOC-030 agents. Only records named DOC-030 inbox were created; no organisation setting was changed on work2. Development runs before the recorded runs left more DOC-030 inbox Requests and records from Diego Salas, Felix Brandt, Karim Aziz and Lena Vogel; they are not credited.
Requests came from the seeded Business Users Oliver Grant and Rosa Iglesias, not Jonas Weber and Amara Nwosu, to keep the shared sign-in link and submission budgets free for other groups.

Competing resolutions and conversions were written by the other legal role through the lab API while the browser write was held. The people-load failure used an aborted browser request; the failed assignment save and failed document upload used controlled 503 browser responses.

Confirmed the author's limitation: the Portal labels the triage assignee "Legal Owner" (seen as "Legal Owner Nadia Haddad" and "Legal Owner Not assigned yet"). The guide states this label; the naming clash is the author's recorded product bug, not a guide failure.

The Filter menu was used only for Status, through its Search filters box. Type, Urgency, Requester and Received date filters and saved views were not exercised. Linked guides were not followed. Older Working team messages were not created.
